programme.desc: Paul’s negative attitude sours his relationship with his mate, Rick. And Tyler is forced to fish solo.

programme.title: Surf Patrol
programme.desc: At the resort town of Byron Bay, lifesavers and the rescue helicopter respond to a cliff base emergency. It's a race against the clock to find the victim. Meanwhile, at Portsea, on Victoria's Mornington Peninsula, Board riders find themselves in trouble in a rip. And some kids from the bush get a tough introduction to the surf.

programme.title: Medical Emergency
programme.desc: A Melbourne tourist has surgery to repair his ankle, while a young mother suffering from 'needle phobia' needs a tetanus injection. Then, a backpacker has a bad reaction to smoking marijuana and a personal trainer arrives with suspected appendicitis.

programme.title: Medical Emergency
programme.desc: Surgeons discover something unexpected when they investigate a personal trainer's suspected appendicitis. Elsewhere, a man's arm is trapped by a post hole digger and doctors have trouble finding a suitable place to insert a drip. Then, an independent 94-year-old arrives with a serious injury to his knee which could result in the loss of his mobility.

programme.title: Episode 21
programme.desc: Nico's efforts to make peace with Fisher misfire with comic and ultimately drastic results. Meanwhile, Roo resolves to probe into Ailsa's mysterious past.

programme.title: (1998) Wedding - Alf & Alisa
programme.desc: Ailsa takes drastic steps to keep Bobby in Summer Bay.

programme.title: (1988) Birth - Christopher Fletcher
programme.desc: Pippa is in labour, but the family has just discovered that this will be no simple birth. Can Pippa and the baby survive?

programme.title: Duct Tape Castaway
